title: Chapter 6625: Am I Late?

Chapter 6625: Am I Late?

Chapter 6625: Am I Late?

“What’s going on?!” The power also engulfed Heaven World.

“A supreme overlord!” The top primal ancestors became alarmed.

Their defense against this aura proved to be an exercise in futility. It sent many emperors flying while the primal ancestors staggered backward with churning vitality.

Everyone’s legs trembled from the pressure. However, the overlord’s aura didn’t target any cultivator alone. Otherwise, no one would be able to stand straight.

Jiu Ning and the others were only one step away from becoming overlords. Alas, they stood no chance against one.

“Am I late?” A pleasant voice came from above. The speaker appeared to be a superior god from ancient times.

Although she spoke with the calmest and gentlest tone, many still dropped to their knees without the courage to raise their head. Alas, an overlord was a colossal existence. No intention of intimidation was necessary and others would still feel an instinctive fear.

This was like ants facing a true dragon. The dragon didn’t need to roar or unleash a fire breath to scare the hell out of the ants.

“Staff Ancestor!” Many recognized her voice.

She became the center of the world even though others couldn’t see her. Once some people mustered enough courage to find her, they were surprised to see her young age.

She was the third to become a primal ancestor and potentially the youngest to become an overlord. This happened after Heavenslay War.

She appeared to be in her early twenties, wearing a tight-fitting dress the color of starlight. Rivers of stars were twisted into threads and then woven into fabric before being tailored perfectly. It showcased her exquisite figure without the slightest overconstriction.

Her slender waist contrasted her prominent curves. Such beauty was astonishing but her face was hidden behind a veil made of mist. The hazy obscurity only accentuated her charm.

Of course, no one dared to have any impure thoughts due to her cultivation and aura. Behind her was a boundless sky, seemingly the abode of the high heaven.

And amidst the phenomena of this boundless sky, one could faintly perceive immortal light being exhaled and inhaled, and immortal daos rising and falling. It seemed that all the mysteries of becoming an immortal were hidden there.

However, deeper within this boundless sky, what one could truly see was likely not heaven, but rather a supreme sin. The heaven or immortals, all must bear one's sin when the time comes.

Therefore, this boundless sky not only made people feel unreachable but also made them want to confess their own guilt, prostrating and awaiting punishment.

“Staff Ancestor!” Participants became alarmed.

Although Staff Ancestor was younger than Visceraless, she still became an overlord. Rumor has it that she was the most talented cultivator in Three Immortals.

However, some disagreed and brought up Xian Chengtian and Zhan Sansheng. After all, Zhan Sansheng actually became an immortal. The counterargument stated Sansheng had a true immortal as a master, hence his success.

On the other hand, some argued Staff Ancestor inherited Heavenly Sin’s resources. Nevertheless, both sides agreed she should be at least top three.

Either way, the remnant resources certainly played a big part. Therefore, many viewed her as Heavenly Sin’s successor.

In reality, she still walked the path started by Desolate Ancestor, not the path of the ancient immortals.

Those who knew about Heavenslay admired her because the remnant foundation should have been damaged grievously after Heavenly Sin’s death. She still somehow made it work.

“Seems like I’m on time.” She gazed at the spring of creation within the maelstrom.

“I want Time Stopper.” She then turned her attention to the group.
